title: Canary observability probes and guardrail notes
body:
Context:
This doc captures a lightweight, visual-first proposal for adding observability-driven probes and guardrail controls to the Rollouts console. The intent is to make canaries and A/B experiments safer by letting owners define "probe scripts" and safety bands (latency/quality/availability) that can trigger automated soft-rollbacks or route-only fallbacks before full rollback.

Why this differs from existing flows:
- Existing rollout flows focus on traffic-slicing and policy selection; this doc centers observability inputs as first-class controls (synthetic probes + golden prompt checks).
- Emphasis on "soft-fallback" where traffic is rerouted to a cheaper-compatible variant while the problematic model is progressively drained instead of immediate full rollback.

High-level goals:
- Give engineers a simple way to attach probe types to a rollout (synthetic latency probe, golden prompt quality probe, end-to-end user journey smoke test).
- Surface live probe signals in the rollout timeline and on the canary health inspector.
- Provide guardrail actions: warn only, auto-stepdown to fallback route, or immediate rollback based on configurable thresholds and evaluation windows.

Proposed UI panels (wireframe notes):
1) Canary config card (left column)
   - Brief: model / variant / traffic percent / duration
   - Link: small "Add probe" button beneath duration (opens modal)
   - Microcopy: "Attach probes to automatically detect regressions during the canary window."

2) Probe composer modal (center)
   - Tabs for probe type: Synthetic Latency, Golden Prompt, Embedding Drift, End-to-end Journey, Custom HTTP Checker
   - Fields (common): name, sampling rate (percent of canary traffic to shadow), evaluation window (30s / 1m / 5m), severity (warn / stepdown / rollback)
   - Example Golden Prompt UI: text area for prompts, expected output matcher (substring / JSON path / fuzzy-match threshold), dataset selector (upload or select existing prompt set)
   - Example Journey UI: sequence builder (step1: infer -> step2: rerank -> step3: final-check) with synthetic user inputs and simple pass/fail rules

3) Health timeline (right column)
   - Time-series stacked view: latency p95, error rate, probe pass rate, model throughput
   - Probe events overlaid as markers with color by severity (green/yellow/red)
   - Hover card: shows probe config, last 5 results, and links to raw traces/requests

4) Guardrail policy editor (bottom)
   - Visual rule builder: when probe X < threshold Y for Z windows -> Action (notify / reduce-traffic-by N% / route-to fallback variant / rollback)
   - Pre-built templates: "Latency spike guardrail", "Quality regressions on golden set", "Sustained error increase"
   - Option to constrain actions by environment/tier (only on Dedicated customers do automatic rollback, hosted defaults to warn+notify)

Behavioral details and heuristics:
- Evaluation windows are discrete buckets (e.g., sliding 1m windows) to reduce flapping. A rule only fires after N consecutive failing windows (configurable).
- Soft-fallback uses a route-level alias so fallback targets can be any compatible model or older pinned version. While fallback is active the problematic variant remains in a draining state for manual investigation.
- For golden prompt checks we support both strict-match and fuzzy-match scoring (cosine on embeddings) to handle open-ended outputs. Thresholds default to conservative values but are editable.
- Drift/embedding probes sample embeddings from a configured dataset and compute centroid distance; users can choose Euclidean/cosine and pick baseline snapshots.

Observability integrations:
- Link probe failures to traces in Console > Traces (pre-filled filter when clicking a marker).
- Export probe time-series to Metrics backend (Prometheus-style labels); allow custom alerting and paging integration.
- Support request sampling to attach a replay for failed golden checks (store request/response for X minutes).

Fail-safe UX and operator controls:
- Any auto-action must show the causal chain in the rollout timeline with a one-click undo for the last 30 minutes (to reduce risk of noisy auto-rollbacks).
- Show a compact "explain" card that lists why the action fired: probe name, rule, windows triggered, delta vs baseline.
- Admin override: org admins can restrict auto-rollback capability per team or per environment (safety knobs).

Edge cases and anti-patterns:
- Noisy probes: recommend sample-rate min 5% for golden prompts; provide smoothing and min-sample thresholds.
- Small traffic canaries: when canary <2% traffic, auto-actions default to warn-only.
- Multi-probe conflicts: allow rule priority and combinators (AND/OR).

Backlog grooming items (rough prioritization):
- M1: Probe composer modal basic types (latency, error, golden prompt), health timeline overlay, basic guardrail rule builder (JIRA-RF-842).
- M2: Soft-fallback route aliasing, undo UX, and admin policy controls (github PR stub exists).
- M3: Embedding drift probes, journey synthetic tests, trace linking, replay store.
- M4: A/B decider integration (allow probes to power experiment winners/losers for automated rollouts).

Open questions (for PM/Engineers):
- What storage/perf cost do we accept for request replays and synthetic journey traces? (SRE ask: retention default?)
- For golden prompt fuzzy-match: should scoring be done server-side via a standard embed model or allow customers to supply a scoring function?
- How to surface per-probe attribution when multiple probes fail simultaneously? Priority or aggregated severity?

Unresolved UX microcopy bits:
- "Soft-fallback" vs "Route-only fallback" naming. Preference in conversation leaned toward "safe-fallback" but needs PM decision.
- Default thresholds language: keep conservative phrasing to avoid surprising rollbacks.

Action items and owners:
- Maya: mock first-pass wireframes for Probe composer modal (due 2025-09-03).
- Arjun: spike on retention and replay storage costs; present options (S3 + TTL, hot store) by 2025-09-10.
- Lina: draft copy for timeline explain cards and severity badges by 2025-09-08.
- Samir: prototype fuzzy-match scoring baseline and include sample metrics for default thresholds by 2025-09-15.

Notes to self / rough ideas to keep:
- Consider a "golden set library" in Console > Optimize so teams can reuse prompt sets across rollouts and pre-test models.
- Small inline CTA: "Run quick smoke now" that executes probes immediately outside canary window for sanity checks.
- Make probe configs exportable in YAML to allow infra-as-code for rollout policies.

References and links:
- Linked artifacts: CONFLUENCE-9876 (probe design doc), JIRA-RF-842 (guardrail feature ticket), github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/213 (initial timeline overlay PR).

Quick sketch checklist for handoff to design/developers:
- [ ] Finalize probe types matrix and default thresholds
- [ ] Wireframe: probe composer modal (desktop + mobile collapsed view)
- [ ] Prototype: timeline markers and hover card UX
- [ ] Backend: metrics schema + probe result ingestion API definition
- [ ] SRE review: replay retention and cost limits

End.
